messages:
Emily (Redwood): Hey team — quick sync on the Orchid co-sell POC. Partner wants a week-long run starting next Monday. We need to lock down infra, SSO, and pricing guardrails.
Sam (Redwood SE): Got it. What are their success criteria?
Liam (Orchid Labs): Main ask: <100ms p95 on short chat prompts, embeddings for search within 50ms, and stable auth (SAML) for internal testers. Also want cost estimate for 10k daily requests.
Priya (Redwood AE): Noted. Pricing ask: is there a quick ballpark for hosted vs dedicated for that volume? Also need legal to sign the partner SOW.
Sam (Redwood SE): Rough thumb: hosted API ~ $0.0008/token (est) with caching should be cheaper; Dedicated depends on committed throughput — likely a small reserved pool. I'll put numbers in an email.
Carlos (Orchid SE): For SAML, Orchid can provide IdP metadata. We need a test SSO environment in 48h. Can Redwood support SAML test setup in dedicated POC mode?
Emily (Redwood): Yes — we can enable SAML in Private/Dedicated. For hosted we can do partner-managed SSO via SCIM + OIDC but it takes longer. For this POC we'll spin a dedicated trial cluster under Redwood Dedicated.
Sam (Redwood SE): Ops checklist: 1) Test cluster provisioning 2) Network peering (if Orchid wants VPC access) 3) SAML config 4) Telemetry hooks + samplers. Who owns network?
Liam (Orchid Labs): Orchid can do VPC peering. We'll open a ticket with our infra team and share CIDRs. Need a runbook for port & firewall rules.
Priya (Redwood AE): I'll start partner SOW and loop legal. Carlos — can you send the SAML metadata and list of tester emails?
Carlos (Orchid SE): Sending now: orchid-idp-metadata.xml + test-users.csv (will DM).
deploy-bot: Cluster provision request received: p-orchid-test-01 queued. ETA ~ 2 hours.
Sam (Redwood SE): For observability during POC we'll enable per-route latency and token-level cost sampling. We'll also instrument a small prompt set for quality baseline. Liam — can Orchid share 10 representative prompts?
Liam (Orchid Labs): Yep sending a JSON with 10 prompts and expected labels. Also want to test reranking for search.
Emily (Redwood): Good. Two blockers to clear now: (A) network peering timeline (B) pricing approval for a short Dedicated trial. Priya, can you approve trial credits or do we need finance sign-off?
Priya (Redwood AE): I can approve up to $2k in trial credits. Anything beyond requires finance sign-off. Estimate based on Sam's numbers and expected token usage.
Sam (Redwood SE): I'll draft an ops runbook snippet to share with Orchid. Will include commands for token creation, test harness, and a sample curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small-1","input":"<prompt>"}'
```
Add note about KV cache warmup and measuring cold-start latency.
Carlos (Orchid SE): Runbook looks good. One more ask: can we record streaming responses for our UX team? Are there privacy flags?
Emily (Redwood): We can enable streaming logs to an s3 bucket with ACL limited to Orchid and Redwood. Need an upload path and IAM role.
Liam (Orchid Labs): We'll share an s3 path and assume role ARN.
deploy-bot: Provision complete: p-orchid-test-01 ready.
Sam (Redwood SE): Cluster is up. I'm kicking off baseline tests now. Posting results in #partnerships when done.
Priya (Redwood AE): Legal emailed partner SOW draft to Lily@orchid. Please reply with any redlines this week.
Liam (Orchid Labs): Received SOW, will review. Quick Q: if we exceed trial traffic, what's fallback? Do we throttle or failover to hosted?
Emily (Redwood): For POC we set soft throttles — requests beyond capacity will get a 429 with explanatory header and fallback to hosted can be enabled per route. We should document fallback behavior in the runbook.
Sam (Redwood SE): Baseline numbers: p95 latency (short prompts) = 85ms, embeddings avg 42ms, token cost estimate for 10k req/day ~ $1.2k hosted (with caching). Uploading telemetry csv in 5.
Carlos (Orchid SE): Nice. Orchid will validate UX flows Tuesday.
Emily (Redwood): Great progress. Next sync Thursday 11am PT to review telemetry and any security q's from Orchid. Thanks all :pray:
